description: FINRA equity short interest: securities with the highest days-to-cover (the classic short-squeeze indicator) + the largest absolute short positions, from the latest bi-monthly settlement. TRUE short interest (not short volume). Use to find squeeze candidates and the most-shorted stocks. FINRA source terms: https://www.finra.org/terms-of-use.
name: short_interest_squeeze
title: Rank Short Interest
